llm.summary: VRRM was in the laggards lane but produced strong positive excess return, only to be stopped out on premature noise. Process fault of premature stop truncated potential profit.
llm.root_cause: VRRM was in the laggards lane but produced strong positive excess return, only to be stopped out on premature noise. Process fault of premature stop truncated potential profit.
llm.lesson: Laggards can reverse sharply, but the stop-loss process is too sensitive to noise, cutting winners short.
llm.engines_credit: The laggards signal engine correctly identified a reversal opportunity; the stop engine failed to protect the position.
alternate_explanations: The stop may have been triggered by a company-specific event or a temporary spike in volatility.
missing_evidence: Intraday price data near the stop trigger
Volatility or spread data for VRRM
Details on stop-loss parameters for laggards-lane entries

signal_hypotheses.feature: Persistence of positive excess return after a laggard reversal signal
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Track 10-day post-signal excess return for laggards with reversal signals
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Reversal should persist, making premature stops costly
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: If returns do not persist and stop is correct, the laggard reversal signal is weak.
